verticalFaqs.question: Does Duet handle custom trip quotes and multi-day expedition inquiries?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes. Duet learns your full trip lineup — half-day floats, full-day rapids, multi-day expeditions — along with pricing, what's included, age minimums, and difficulty levels. When someone asks about a 3-day trip for 6, it drafts a complete reply with the right details. You review, tweak if needed, and send.

verticalFaqs.question: I'm off-grid on multi-day trips. Does Duet still work?
verticalFaqs.answer: That's exactly the problem Duet solves. While you're on the river with no signal, Duet drafts replies to every inquiry that comes in. When you're back in range, your drafts are waiting — just review and send. Most guides tell us it eliminates the backlog they used to face after every multi-day trip.
